Acting President Hafiz Uddin pays tribute to Liberation War martyrs at Savar
2026-07-26T13:13:20+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/acting-president-hafiz-uddin-pays-tribute-liberation-war-martyrs-savar-4232796

Acting President Hafiz Uddin Ahmad today paid tribute to the martyrs of the Liberation War at the National Memorial in Savar.

He laid a wreath at the memorial at around 11:40am.

After placing the wreath, the acting president observed a moment of silence in memory of the martyrs.

He was also given a guard of honour by a contingent of the armed forces. Later, he signed the visitors' book.

The acting president is also scheduled to pay tribute to former president Ziaur Rahman and former prime minister Begum Khaleda Zia at Sher-e-Bangla Nagar in Dhaka. He will lay wreaths at their graves at the Zia Mausoleum in Zia Udyan.

Following the tribute programmes, he will go to Bangabhaban to carry out the head of state's regular official duties.

Hafiz Uddin assumed the responsibilities of acting president on Friday in his capacity as speaker of the Jatiya Sangsad, in accordance with the Constitution, following the resignation of Mohammed Shahabuddin.

Shahabuddin submitted his resignation letter to the speaker under Article 50(3) of the Constitution, citing ill health.
